description: Golden evaluation cases for Simon's Stage 4 Synthesis Scout (simon-synthesis-scout), covering multi-candidate synthesis, single-clip second-take guidance, and failure modes (shortlist cap violation, hallucinated timestamps, telemetry leaks).

cases.brief: Find emerging NYC solo vocalists who reinterpret familiar songs with stripped-back acoustic arrangements, exceptional dynamic control, and distinctive vocal timbre.
cases.context: Evaluated candidate leads (lead_olivia_dean, lead_devon_cole, lead_luna_jinna) with timestamped ClipEvidence from Mahogany Sessions and Sofar Sounds NYC.

report.brief: Find emerging NYC solo vocalists who reinterpret familiar songs with stripped-back acoustic arrangements, exceptional dynamic control, and distinctive vocal timbre.
report.headline: Shortlisted 3 solo vocalists with verified timestamped observations matching stripped-back acoustic brief.

steps.title: Loaded upstream candidate leads and evaluated clip evidence from simon-db
steps.looking_at: 3 candidate leads and 6 timestamped clip observations across soul, folk, and R&B.

steps.title: Mapped vocal phrasing and dynamic range against taste brief criteria
steps.analysis: Identified standout mic dynamics on Olivia Dean at 1:12 and intimate acoustic phrasing on Devon Cole and Luna Jinna.

steps.title: Saved 3 artist assessments and top-3 listening shortlist to simon-db

findings.title: Olivia Dean
findings.summary: Rank 1: Soulful dynamic modulation and warm chest-to-head transitions on live acoustic session.

findings.title: Devon Cole
findings.summary: Rank 2: Stripped-back acoustic guitar arrangement with crisp diction and playful vocal trills.

findings.title: Luna Jinna
findings.summary: Rank 3: Smoky lower-register phrasing and sustained vibrato on live acoustic ballad.

output.synthesis_summary: Evaluated 3 candidate vocalists against the stripped-back acoustic taste brief. Shortlisted all 3, prioritizing Olivia Dean's dynamic phrasing at the mic, with Devon Cole and Luna Jinna offering contrasting intimate live arrangements.

assessments.fit_rationale: Exceptional breath control and dynamic transitions between intimate chest voice and head resonance on acoustic guitar backing in clip_01 at 1:12.
open_questions: Does live vocal projection hold unamplified in larger 250-cap rooms?
Confirm availability of original acoustic arrangements versus studio production.

assessments.fit_rationale: Playful vocal ornamentation and precise pitch intonation on live single-take performance in clip_02 at 0:45.
open_questions: Has only one evaluated live clip; verify consistency across an extended 30-minute set.

assessments.fit_rationale: Smoky resonant lower register with restrained vibrato that anchors the intimate mood requested in the brief in clip_03 at 1:30.
open_questions: Confirm whether stage setup requires acoustic grand piano or electric keyboard DI.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 1:12, Dean shifts effortlessly from hushed conversational delivery into a resonant acoustic crescendo without clipping or pitch wobble.
shortlist.what_to_hear_next: Listen to clip_01b to confirm her sustained falsetto control on lower-tempo ballads.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 0:45, Cole locks percussive vocal phrasing into the acoustic guitar rhythm with crisp diction and playful syncopation.
shortlist.what_to_hear_next: Seek a second live clip with a slower tempo to evaluate emotional resonance beyond rhythmic hooks.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 1:30, Jinna demonstrates deep, controlled vibrato in her lower register that perfectly fulfills the brief's distinctive timbre requirement.
shortlist.what_to_hear_next: Check live performance with full rhythm section to test vocal presence against drums.

findings.title: Acantha Lang
findings.summary: Rank 1: Powerful neo-soul timbre with proven multi-session live track record.

findings.title: Maya Vance

output.synthesis_summary: Assessed 2 promising neo-soul vocalists. Acantha Lang brings verified multi-room live experience, while Maya Vance presents high vocal promise from a single living-room take with explicit second-take guidance.

assessments.fit_rationale: Mature, resonant neo-soul vocal delivery with strong projection and dynamic control demonstrated across multiple live rooms.
open_questions: Confirm whether NYC residency dates align with European touring schedule.

assessments.fit_rationale: Intimate warm jazz phrasing with subtle microtonal inflections in clip_02 at 0:28; outstanding bedroom-pop texture.
open_questions: Single clip only: living-room acoustic capture does not verify uncompressed stage projection or pitch stability under stage monitoring.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 2:05, Lang commands the room with authoritative soul vocal power and flawless pitch stability on the bridge crescendo.
shortlist.what_to_hear_next: Listen to her stripped-back acoustic duet to evaluate dynamics when not backed by a full horn section.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 0:28, Vance delivers close-mic vocal breathiness and delicate pitch inflection matching the bedroom jazz brief.
shortlist.what_to_hear_next: Scout MUST hear a live venue or open-mic clip with ambient room noise before booking to confirm vocal audibility over an audience.
